data.name: Construction Simulator 3 - Pocket Edition
data.detailed_description:
Complete your Construction Simulator collection with Construction Simulator 3!

Discover an idyllic European town and experience the thrill of construction work with over 50 officially licensed vehicles from 14 world-renowned brands such as Caterpillar, Liebherr, CASE, Bobcat, Palfinger, STILL, MAN, ATLAS, Bell, BOMAG, WIRTGEN GmbH, JOSEPH VÖGELE AG, HAMM AG and MEILLER Kipper.

Take on a wide variety of diverse and challenging contracts that will put your skills to the test. Build and repair roads and houses, shape the skyline of your city, and steadily expand your vehicle fleet as your company grows. With each completed job, you unlock new opportunities, vehicles, and machines to take your business to the next level.

Explore a detailed European-inspired map filled with many construction sites. Whether you are building residential homes, repairing streets, or taking on large-scale projects like bridge construction, every contract offers a new challenge and hours of engaging gameplay. Landscaping and gardening jobs add further variety, letting you prove your abilities in different fields of construction.

With realistic controls and a broad range of vehicles, Construction Simulator 3 delivers an authentic construction experience that fans of the series won’t want to miss. From heavy machinery to compact equipment, every machine is faithfully recreated to provide a true-to-life feel.

This is a must-have for franchise collectors and anyone who enjoys realistic simulation gameplay.

Key Features:

• Over 50 vehicles and machines from 14 officially licensed brands

• More than 70 varied and challenging contracts

• Includes road and bridge construction, gardening, and landscaping

• Supports keyboard & mouse for precise control

data.short_description: In Construction Simulator 3, explore a European town with vehicles from Caterpillar, Liebherr, CASE, MAN, Bell, BOMAG, MEILLER Kipper and more. Take on contracts, build roads and houses, expand your fleet, and grow your company!
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Quad Q6600 @ 2.40GHz or AMD Phenom II X3 720
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon HD 6850 1GB VRAM or Nvidia GeForce GTX 460 768MB VRAM or Intel HD 520
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 11 compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3220M@3.3Ghz | i5-3320@2.6GhZ or AMD Phenom II X4 965 | AMD FX-6100 Six-Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon HD 7870 2GB VRAM or Nvidia GeForce GTX 660 2GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
